capture.original_context:
Key signatures, part one.

C major has no sharps or flats in its key signature.

Part two, a week later.

A minor uses exactly the same notes as C major, so A minor is called the relative minor of C major.
capture.original_input: Why do C major and A minor look the same on the staff?

learner_goal: Find the relative minor of a major key.

items.canonical: relative minor of C major = A minor
quotes: C major has no sharps or flats in its key signature.
A minor uses exactly the same notes as C major
items.statement: A minor is the relative minor of C major: both have no sharps or flats.
